scheduler: 2epoch linear warmup; cosine to10% over20 epochs
loss: .45 weightedCE([1,4]) + .45 foregroundDice + .1 boundaryDice(morphological3x3); ignore255 and invalid neighborhoods excluded
augmentation: same frozen v2 scale .75..1.5 / paint-centred75% patch / photometric / hflip
checkpoint_selection: maximum original-resolution native FP32 VAL paint IoU over frozen14threshold grid; include zero-step baseline epoch0; VAL only
fresh_evaluation: new80 images from two unseen recording groups after selected checkpoint/threshold/numeric gate frozen; baseline and candidate once
regression: old TEST cohorts only separately labelled regression; never fitting or selection
old_VAL_role: reused development only, not independent final accuracy
